description:
List live prediction markets ordered by 24h volume. Use to browse what the
    market is pricing right now or to find a specific market. `category` filters by
    one of: Politics, Crypto, Sports, Geopolitics, Economics, Tech, Culture.
    `search` filters by keyword in the market question. Browsing tool; to answer a specific question about one event use get_market_odds.

category.description: Optional category: Politics, Crypto, Sports, Geopolitics, Economics, Tech or Culture
category.title: Category

limit.description: Maximum number of markets to return
limit.title: Limit

search.description: Optional keyword that must appear in the market question
search.title: Search
